title: Payment Gateway Timeout Cascades (Stripe API 504s)

activeRunbook.title: P1 Payment Gateway Cascade Mitigation Runbook

steps.title: Enable Secondary Gateway Fallback Route
steps.explanation: Forces traffic to route through secondary payment provider while Stripe resolves upstream issues.

steps.title: Expand Payment HTTP Connection Pool Limit
steps.command: kubectl set env deployment/payment-service HTTP_POOL_MAX_CONNECTIONS=250 HTTP_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS=3000
steps.explanation: Increases socket pool headroom and lowers read timeout from 10s to 3s to prevent thread blocking.

steps.title: Scale Out Checkout API Replicas
steps.explanation: Absorbs queued worker backlog and restores sub-100ms request handling.

steps.title: Drain Dead-Letter Retry Queue
steps.explanation: Replays dropped transaction intents through the secondary gateway without double-charging.

title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion & Deadlock

activeRunbook.title: P1 PostgreSQL Deadlock & Pool Starvation Remediation

steps.title: Terminate Blocking DDL Process
steps.explanation: Immediately releases the AccessExclusiveLock on user_sessions, unblocking all queued transactions.

steps.title: Drain Stale Lock Waiters
steps.command: psql -h account-db-primary -U postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND query_start < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 seconds';"
steps.explanation: Clears abandoned connections held open by timed-out client sockets.

steps.title: Reload PgBouncer Pool Configuration
steps.command: pgbouncer-cli -h pgbouncer-service -p 6432 -c 'PAUSE users_db; RELOAD; RESUME users_db;'
steps.explanation: Refreshes server socket pool allocations and resets client connection counters.

steps.title: Verify Session Table Query Performance
steps.command: psql -h account-db-primary -U postgres -c 'EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id = 9999 LIMIT 1;'
steps.explanation: Confirms read query latency is back to expected sub-millisecond execution.
